reason: I grab my energy drink at the petrol station or Albert on the way, and I'm not ordering cans online. Unless my lunch bistro happens to stock it, I'll never actually come across it, so it doesn't happen.
objection: Where can I actually buy it? 'Selected cafés and bistros' doesn't tell me anything, and it's not in the shops I go to every day.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it in the fridge at Albert, Tesco or the petrol station I pass, or at my lunch bistro, so I can try one can without any effort.
